title: Two Targets, One Jump
setup: Black's king on g8 and rook on e8 stand where a single knight jump can reach them both.
hint: Find the square that checks the king and hits the rook in the same jump, then make sure no pawn guards it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nf6+}} is a fork: from f6 the knight checks the king on g8 and attacks the rook on e8. With the g-pawn gone, nothing guards f6, and a knight's check cannot be blocked.

The king has to move, and {{Nxe8}} collects the rook.
